name: Gästehaus Gruber
beschreibung:
Located at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser, Gaestehaus Gruber in Scheffau is an inviting alpine retreat. Bright rooms with balconies provide splendid vistas of neighbouring peaks and alpine meadows.

Lake Hintersteiner See, the SkiWelt cable cars, and scenic hiking paths are just a short trip away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Gruber in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser provides peace and relaxation surrounded by nature.
